Treatment summary
The patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with a knee injury that is consistent with the kind and force of the
impact described. Over the course of nine visits, care included evaluation, conservative management, and progressive
reassessment. The course of treatment ran somewhat lonegr than is typical for this type of injury, which we attribute to the
patient's gradual rate of functional recovery. On examination, several findings support the presence of a true knee injury,
including localized tenderness and reduced range of motion on the affected side. Other tests performed during the evaluation
returned normal results. The patient's history includes a minor strain in the same region several years ago, which resolved fully
without lasting limitation and does not appear to account for the current presentation. Billing records reflect single charges for
each service rendered, with no repeated or duplicate entries. Recovery is ongoing, and follow-up will continue to monitor
progress and adjust the plan of care as needed.

  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
